scenes.name: Lumie Sunrise Alarm
scenes.vo: The Lumie Sunrise Alarm. It brightens slowly for half an hour before the alarm, so you wake up in daylight now the clocks have gone back. Amazon has it at thirty three ninety nine on a limited time deal, against a forty nine ninety nine R R P.

scenes.name: vs Argos
scenes.note: £15 less than Argos, £6 less than Boots
scenes.vo: Argos sells the exact same one at forty nine pounds, and Boots is thirty nine ninety nine. On Amazon it's thirty three ninety nine. That's fifteen pounds back in your pocket.
